pkgmetadata.longdescription: ytrace is a header-only C++20 tracing library with runtime-controllable trace points. It provides macros for structured logging at different levels (log, trace, debug, info, warn, error) with optional spdlog backend. A Unix-domain socket control interface allows enabling or disabling individual trace points at runtime without recompilation.

use.flag: Build the ytrace-ctl runtime control utility
